title: Delivery notification contains an unusable tracking link

plan.situation: Vela Morn, the recipient, wrote in through the Customer portal. The tracking link in her delivery notification does not open, and she wants the right way to find parcel DL-017 in the order portal. Plover Arc Logistics' Notification support has confirmed that their template cut the link short. They also confirmed that the notification belongs to this recipient's account and that the shipment reference in their order record is correct. The desk can give her the reference and plain search steps in the same portal thread, without any link. It can also ask the carrier to fix the template and send a corrected notification.

facts.fact: The DL-017 notification link was cut short by Plover Arc's template
The account-linked notification belongs to this recipient
The shipment reference DL-017 is correct in the carrier's order record
Vela Morn reports the link does not open and asks how to find the parcel in the order portal
The request came in through the Customer portal, which is an account-linked session

missing_information: Whether searching DL-017 in the order portal shows the parcel to the customer
When Plover Arc will fix the template or reissue a corrected notification
The current stage and location of the parcel (not needed for this step)
risk_flags: The broken link is unknown content: the customer must not be asked to open it or any other link, and no links are sent
No delivery time or parcel status is stated because the carrier has not given one

authority_map.controls: Notification template, fixing the link and reissuing the notification
Confirming whether the parcel appears in her order portal

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: No earlier desk promise. This is the customer's first request (event 002), and the carrier confirmed the reference is correct (event 001)

plan.decision_summary: Give Vela Morn the correct reference DL-017 and plain search steps in her Customer portal thread with no link, and ask Plover Arc Notification support to fix the cut-off template and send a corrected notification.
plan.rationale: The carrier has confirmed that the reference is correct and that the notification belongs to this recipient. The desk can therefore safely give her the reference in her account's portal thread. Steering her away from the broken link and sending no new links avoids unknown-link risk. Only the carrier can fix the template itself.

actions.subject: How to find your parcel DL-017
actions.body:
Hello Vela,

Thank you for letting us know. The carrier has confirmed that the link in your notification was cut short by a fault in their message template. Please don't use that link.

Your correct shipment reference is DL-017. To find your parcel, sign in to your order portal the way you normally do (not through the notification link). Then type DL-017 into the tracking or order search box.

We have asked the carrier to fix the template and send you a corrected notification. Please reply here to let us know whether DL-017 shows up for you. We will never ask you to follow a link or share a password or code to track your parcel.

Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
actions.purpose: Give the customer the correct reference and safe search steps without any link, and ask her to confirm it works

actions.subject: DL-017: cut-off tracking link – please fix template and reissue notification
actions.body:
Hello Notification support,

Thank you for confirming (2026-02-18 09:00 UTC) that the DL-017 notification link was cut short by your template, and that the shipment reference is correct in your order record. The recipient has told us through the Customer portal that the link does not open. We have given her the reference DL-017 so she can search for it in the order portal.

Please could you (1) fix the template fault and (2) send the recipient a corrected notification for DL-017 through her account. Please reply today, 2026-02-18, with confirmation once both are done, or with the time you expect to finish. Please also let us know if other notifications sent from the same template could be affected.

This is a request, not a confirmation.

Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
actions.purpose: Ask the carrier, who owns the template, to fix it and send a corrected notification

actions.body: Check for Plover Arc Notification support's confirmation that the template is fixed and the DL-017 notification was reissued, and for Vela Morn's reply on whether DL-017 shows up in the portal. If the carrier has not replied, chase by Email. If the customer cannot find the parcel, ask the carrier to look into the order portal record.
actions.purpose: Same-working-day check under the carrier_ops queue rule

not_doing: Not sending any link, including a rebuilt tracking link, because links are not allowed and the broken one is unknown content
Not asking the customer to open the broken link or to share passwords, codes or account details
Not stating a delivery time, location or parcel status, because the carrier has not given one
Not promising when the corrected notification will arrive, because the carrier has not given a time
plan.follow_up: At 2026-02-18 17:00 UTC: check whether the customer can see DL-017 in the portal and whether the carrier has confirmed the template fix and reissue. If the carrier is silent, chase by Email. If DL-017 does not show up for the customer, ask Plover Arc to look into the portal record.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Give Vela Morn the correct reference DL-017 and plain search steps in her Customer portal thread with no link, and ask Plover Arc Notification support to fix the cut-off template and send a corrected notification.

issues.problem: case_parameters.shipment_stage 'on_route' is not supported by the record. Nothing says what stage the parcel is at.
The message says 'We have asked the carrier…'. That is only true if action 1 is sent first or at the same time.
issues.fix: Send the carrier request before or together with the customer message, or change the wording to 'We are asking the carrier…'.

issues.problem: The lint flagged 'password'. It appears only in a reassurance that the desk will never ask for one, which is acceptable.

review.summary: I'm approving this plan. It answers the customer's first request in her verified portal thread. It gives her the shipment reference the carrier confirmed and safe search steps with no links, and it asks the carrier, which owns the template, to fix it and reissue the notification. It doesn't over-claim timing or status, and the same-day follow-up is set correctly. There are only minor issues: the shipment stage is unsupported, and the two messages should go out in the right order.
